bundle.shortDescription: Reverse-engineer SQL Server schemas into ERD diagrams
bundle.longDescription: SchemaCraft connects to Microsoft SQL Server, extracts the schema, persists it in a portable .scraft project and renders interactive entity-relationship diagrams with high-fidelity SVG, HTML and PDF export.
